rates.title: Sindh minimum wages from 1 July 2026
rates.official_announcement: Sindh Labour & HR Department website news item: 'Minimum Wage Unskilled Rs. 43,000/-, Skilled Rs. 53,350/-, Semi-Skilled Rs. 44,484/- & Highly Skilled Rs. 55,626/- w.e.f 01-07-2026' (posted 22 Sep 2026; notification PDFs posted 17 Aug 2026).

unverified_details.coverage: Reported as covering permanent, temporary, contract, daily-wage and piece-rate workers; semi-skilled/skilled/highly-skilled rates reported as applying to 60 industries.
unverified_details.why_unverified: These details come from the July 2026 proposed notification as reported by Business Recorder and The News. The final notification PDF is a scanned image that could not be machine-read. Read the PDF manually before using them.

sources.publisher: Labour & Human Resources Department, Government of Sindh

verification.notes: Monthly amounts verified on the official Labour Department website (news item of 22 Sep 2026), re-checked 2026-10-17. Both notification PDFs are scanned images, so the amounts rest on the website announcement until the PDFs are read manually.

sources.publisher: Labour & Human Resources Department, Government of Sindh (notification titles)

history.notes: History is for context only. Always quote the current rate from 'rates'. The Labour Department site also lists a 'Minimum Wage Notification 2023' (03 Nov 2023); its amount was not read, so 2023 is missing from this history.
